_comment: Example configuration for Infra Monitor. Copy this to machines.json (next to the app / exe) and replace the example values with your own. All hosts below use reserved documentation values (192.0.2.0/24 is TEST-NET-1, example.com is reserved) and MUST be edited before anything is monitored.
_comment_gate: Optional network gate. Machines with scope 'local' are only polled while you are on a known network. Leave gate_domains empty and gate_fingerprints empty to disable the gate (then 'local' machines are treated as always reachable is NOT assumed - learn a network first, or mark them 'public'). Run 'InfraMonitor.exe --learn-gate <name>' on each trusted network to record its gateway.
_comment_allowlist: CIDRs/IPs pushed to each machine's fail2ban ignoreip so routine monitoring can never lock you out. Keep loopback + your own private ranges.
_comment_jump_host: Name of a machine in this list used to reach 'local' machines that have no explicit 'via'. Leave empty for all-direct setups.
_comment_intrusion: A logged-in SSH session from outside these CIDRs, or as a user not listed here, is reported as a possible intrusion.
_comment_allowed_peers: Extra IPs/CIDRs that are 'us'. Every monitored machine is trusted automatically; list only additional trusted peers here.

machines._comment: A publicly reachable bastion/relay host, checked directly and used as jump_host for the local machines below.
machines.name: relay-1

machines._comment: A GPU box on a private network, reached through relay-1. check_nvidia turns on the optional nvidia-smi health check.
machines.name: gpu-1

machines._comment: A plain public server - no GPU, no optional service checks. Just health, load, disk, logins.
machines.name: web-1

_comment_local_watch: Watches THIS Windows PC (the one the SSH checks can never see). trusted_images holds full paths you have judged safe.
_comment_theme: Appearance. 'system' follows the desktop's light/dark setting live; 'dark' or 'light' pins it. Also changed from the dashboard header or the tray menu.
